bug_fix: VideoCacheStats.newest_mtime_ns uses st_mtime_ns (int, nanoseconds) instead of st_mtime (float, seconds). Fields renamed: oldest_mtime->oldest_mtime_ns, newest_mtime->newest_mtime_ns (both int|None). _is_cleanup_candidate now takes now_ns:int and compares in nanoseconds. get_video_cache_stats and clean_video_cache use time.time_ns().
